name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began with a childhood obsession with Formula 1. He spent countless hours tinkering with model cars and devouring technical manuals. He pursued a degree in Aerospace Engineering at Imperial College London, specializing in aerodynamics. After graduating, he joined a small Formula 3 team, gaining valuable experience in wind tunnel testing and CFD analysis. He then moved to a larger World Rally team, where he honed his skills in developing aerodynamic packages for diverse and challenging terrains. 

Alistair's approach to aerodynamics is rooted in a deep understanding of first principles, coupled with a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. He believes in data-driven decision-making and rigorous testing to validate new concepts. He is known for his ability to translate complex engineering concepts into practical solutions that improve vehicle performance. His calm demeanor and sharp analytical skills make him a valuable asset to any team. 

What sets Alistair apart is his ability to balance innovation with reliability. He's not afraid to push the boundaries of aerodynamic design, but he always prioritizes solutions that are robust and easy to maintain in the demanding environment of rallycross racing.

physical.description: Alistair is a man of medium height with a lean build, giving him a focused and athletic appearance.
